theory.title: So y neither con verbos auxiliares
theory.explanation: Usa so + auxiliar + sujeto para mostrar que estás de acuerdo con una afirmación positiva, y neither + auxiliar + sujeto para coincidir con una afirmación negativa. Elige el auxiliar según el tiempo verbal original: So do I, So can she, Neither have we.
theory.tip: So para coincidir con una frase afirmativa; neither para una negativa. Mantén el auxiliar correcto.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 1
patterns.pattern: I enjoy documentaries. So do I.
examples:
I enjoy documentaries. So do I.
→ Me gustan los documentales. A mí también.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 2
patterns.pattern: She hasn't seen the latest episode. Neither have I.
examples:
She hasn't seen the latest episode. Neither have I.
→ Ella no ha visto el último episodio. Yo tampoco.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 3
patterns.pattern: They can speak three languages. So can we.
examples:
They can speak three languages. So can we.
→ Ellos pueden hablar tres idiomas. Nosotros también.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 4
patterns.pattern: He doesn't like reality shows. Neither does his brother.
examples:
He doesn't like reality shows. Neither does his brother.
→ A él no le gustan los programas de telerrealidad. A su hermano tampoco.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 5
patterns.pattern: I've read that review. So have I.
examples:
I've read that review. So have I.
→ He leído esa reseña. Yo también.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 6
patterns.pattern: We were surprised by the ending. So were they.
examples:
We were surprised by the ending. So were they.
→ El final nos sorprendió. A ellos también.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 7
patterns.pattern: I won't watch the programme. Neither will I.
examples:
I won't watch the programme. Neither will I.
→ No veré el programa. Yo tampoco.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 8
patterns.pattern: She is interested in journalism. So am I.
examples:
She is interested in journalism. So am I.
→ A ella le interesa el periodismo. A mí también.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 9
patterns.pattern: They didn't enjoy the film. Neither did we.
examples:
They didn't enjoy the film. Neither did we.
→ No disfrutaron de la película. Nosotros tampoco.

patterns.label: So y neither con verbos auxiliares · 10
patterns.pattern: I would rather read the book. So would I.
examples:
I would rather read the book. So would I.
→ Prefiero leer el libro. Yo también.

content.passage: After watching a documentary, two friends compared their opinions. Mia said she enjoyed programmes about science, and Leo replied, 'So do I.' She had not seen the latest episode, and Leo said, 'Neither have I.' They both thought the presenter was clear and reliable. Leo did not like the advertisements, and Mia agreed: 'Neither do I.' They decided to watch another episode together because they shared similar interests.

items.prompt: Talk about a programme you enjoy and invite someone to agree.
items.modelAnswer: I enjoy different kinds of media because they help me learn about the world and relax. I usually choose programmes that are informative and well presented. I also like discussing films and documentaries with friends because we often have different opinions. Although some online stories are not reliable, I try to check the source before sharing them. In the future, I think media will become more personalised, but good journalism will remain important.

content.audioTranscript: A: Did you watch the new documentary last night? B: Yes, the audience really enjoyed it. A: The presenter was excellent. B: I haven't seen the next episode yet. A: I read a positive review online. B: Was it from a reliable source? A: Yes, although there was one advertisement during the break. B: I watched it on a streaming service. A: What's your opinion of the series? B: It's a very interesting programme.
